settings.heading: AI
settings.description: The AI writing assistant in pages, AI autofill properties in databases, the AI chat and semantic search.
settings.enabledHint: When on, members can send page content and row values they can see to the AI provider below. Turn off to keep this workspace's content away from it.
settings.memoryHint: When on, the AI chat keeps short notes about people who tell it about themselves, and sends them with their later questions. Each person can turn it off for themselves. When off, the Memory view is hidden and nobody's questions carry notes; the notes are kept, not deleted. Agents' runs then carry no notes and propose none either.
settings.webSearch: Web search in the AI chat
settings.webSearchHint: When on, the AI chat may search the web with the server's search service and read web pages, only reading: after it read from the web, every change it wants to make is asked about. Research mode searches the web too. Questions and page text it searches with leave the workspace for the search service.
settings.notConfigured: No AI provider or embeddings model is set up on this server, so AI features are off. An admin can set them up with the AI_PROVIDER and AI_MODEL (and AI_EMBEDDINGS_MODEL) environment variables (see the README).
settings.noProvider: None: the writing assistant, AI properties and the AI chat need AI_PROVIDER and AI_MODEL.
settings.semanticValue: Search also finds pages by meaning, with the embeddings model {model}.
settings.semanticOff: Off: search finds words only. An admin can turn it on with AI_EMBEDDINGS_MODEL.
